title: A lane finds triage's session without searching recent sessions
why: Lane lane-lint-no-silent-pass could not find triage: no session tagged cs-build:triage for claude-settings showed in its 140 most recent sessions (coordinator, 20:35 CST Nov 7). A lane that cannot find triage cannot hand it a step change.
note: Measured by triage at 20:36 CST Nov 7: triage 6 (session_013NEJL42Sv3tJkjpzY7bExj) already carries the tags cs-build:triage and cs-repo:shivinate7/claude-settings. It was made on Nov 3, so it falls outside a search of the 140 most recent sessions. The tag is present, so the fix is the other half of the coordinator's pair: the lane brief carries triage's session id, or the search filters by tag rather than reading recent sessions. Coordinator starts a lane on the slug. Started by the coordinator, 20:37 CST Nov 7, in lane session_013NEJL3ixw3qjVWMvVLFtg5. Scope: the brief template names the coordinator, runner and triage ids, and the brief guard refuses a Lane brief with no `Triage: session_<id>` line. Updated 20:37 CST. Built as #1748 (head cd4912da0): round 2 sonnet PASS; with runner 8. A docs follow-up stacks on it (coordinator 21:13 CST; updated 21:13 CST). Follow-up #2049 (lane role-ids-in-brief, session_013NEJL3otrRs5sCK9CN5FpB) moves the roster's home to the record branch's CLAUDE.md. Its question was answered from rulings by triage, 08:35 CST Nov 8, with no page item (P38, P44): the owner's words of 2026-10-28 18:02 CDT are only "follow it to the tee, spawn all that it requires", process only; the roster-home clause is a writer's description. project-ops step 4's sentence "keep no second copy in the repo" first appears in 17e9675c0 ("o16: package the project way of working as the project-ops skill", 2026-10-26) with no owner quote; it predates the owner's words of 10-28 (corrected 09:09 CST from lane role-ids-in-brief; `git log --full-history -S`). The home repo's CLAUDE.md already names the roster in CLAUDE.md on branch roadmap. So #2049 goes ahead with option a.
